lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So how do you get the knife?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Is there blood on the knife?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You told us in another interview that you cut her throat. Did you cut her throat?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you tell us that? Brendan, why did you tell us that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well, what’s the truth? Tell me what the truth is.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That I stabbed her in the stomach.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, you know people get nervous when they, when they lie. OK. So you stabbed her in the stomach. Is she alive? You said Steven stabbed her first. Is she still alive when you stab her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was she talking, were her eyes open anything like that?
